:::'''Xiaobao''': I-I don't have a dad, and my mom is always late...
:::'''Xiaobao''': Mom said that she would come back as soon as the Hero Play was over every day and I'll just need to concentrate on the play. But she doesn't always keep her promise...
::'''Xiaobao''': I remember that once, my mom didn't come to pick me up when the play was over. Sister Chixia happened to pass the theater, so she bought me a big, sweet sugar figure...
::'''Xiaobao''': She asked me if I like watching plays. I said yes and I always want to be a big hero!
::'''Xiaobao''': And she told me that a great hero should start from small things, like waiting patiently for mom to come home.
::'''Xiaobao''': ...I know I'm being annoying. I must apologize to you and Sister Junyan!
::'''Xiaobao''': I won't do this again. I promise I'll wait patiently for the show to start!
